text:
tessa: Heads-up: preflight for RC-2026.03.24 failed during integration stage, blocking promote.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline #4801 FAILED - stage: integration. Job: integration-preflight-analytics. Logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/4801

maria: looking now — CI shows repeated cache TTL evictions and an artifact checksum mismatch in one worker. snippet: ```
W cache/evict.go:142 ttl expired shard=3 key=projects:987:seed
E artifact/verify.go:67 checksum mismatch: expected=sha256:abc123 got=sha256:def456
E integration_test.go:78 assert: got 0 items, want 5
```

sam: checksum mismatch is odd — did we change build process?

jin: we rolled a small change to the runtime image that adjusted layering, but we ran the publish job twice earlier which could explain the mismatch on a replicated blob. I verified the canonical registry image for 2026.03.21 is correct.

tessa: so two separate issues: TTL eviction causing flakes + one bad artifact copy. We can't promote until integration green. Options?

maria: options I see: a) abort and pin to last-good runtime image (2026.03.21) and re-promote, b) rerun CI after cleaning cache shards on the fleet, c) rerun publish to fix bad blob then rerun pipeline, d) manual promote with risk accepted.

alex: manual promote unacceptable with checks failing. I'd prefer pin+promote (a) as lowest blast radius. We should also triage artifact publish root cause.

sam: pinning sounds safe. How do we pin in deploy-bot?

deploy-bot: To promote with override set pinned_runtime_image and extra_retries use: `/promote RC-2026.03.24 --pinned-runtime=2026.03.21 --integration-retries=4`

jin: if we pin now I can replay the publish pipeline to regenerate the artifact blob and run a targeted repair to nodes that saw the bad copy. That should let us unpin tomorrow after verification. ETA ~3h.

tessa: change window closes in 45m. If pin takes <30m we can finish within window. Otherwise we postpone.

maria: i'll attempt pin-promote now. deploy-bot run the promote with pinned_runtime=2026.03.21 and integration_retries=4. Also add note for release notes: "temporary runtime image pin due to artifact publish inconsistency and cache-TTL evictions; will unpin after remediation."

deploy-bot: Received promote request: promote RC-2026.03.24 -> prod with overrides {pinned_runtime: "2026.03.21", integration_retries: 4}. Dry-run checks in progress...

deploy-bot: Dry-run failed: registry check - artifact blob missing on replica eu-west-1. Recommend fix blob replication before promote or allow promote with single-region fallback. Set allow_single_region_fallback=true to proceed anyway.

sam: hmm. single-region fallback increases risk for EU users. Is the replica repair quick?

jin: replica sync should be <10m if I trigger re-replicate. I can start replication now.

tessa: do it. We'll wait up to 20m for replication. If replica still not healthy, we abort the window.

maria: starting replication job now (link: https://infra.redwood/replicate/ops/994). Jin please report when it's done.

jin: replication job started. monitoring logs.

(18m later)

jin: replication completed on eu-west-1, artifact checksums now match.

deploy-bot: Re-running dry-run checks... Dry-run OK. Starting promote pipeline: https://ci.redwood/internal/4802

(10m later)

deploy-bot: Promote pipeline completed: SUCCESS. RC-2026.03.24 promoted to prod with pinned_runtime=2026.03.21. Release notes draft: https://docs.redwood/release/rc-2026.03.24/draft

maria: thanks. Follow-ups: (1) jin to open ENG-4325 to fix publish idempotency, (2) alex to schedule cache shard softlimit tuning and a fleet-wide cache sweep, (3) sam will update release notes with the blurb and mark unpin window tomorrow 09:30 UTC.

jin: ENG-4325 created: https://tracker.redwood/ENG-4325 - implementing idempotent publish + health check.

tessa: marking thread action=promote-with-pin owner=maria followup=ENG-4325. Closing for now. :white_check_mark:
